_comment: Best-effort map of Ramp review letter-IDs to numeric rule refs (the 'id' field in packages/rules/rules.json). Source: sources/examples/ramp-review-report.pdf (MA Ramp review, 9 Oct 2026). ref=null means no existing numeric rule matched -> candidate NEW rule sourced to the Ramp report (NOT added to rules.json). Mapping is documentation only; matched on test name/meaning, not authored. confidence high=clear 1:1 meaning match, low=family/approximate/uncertain.

B1.name: Approved button
B1.rule_name: Buttons use one of Apple's four approved calls to action

C1.name: First reply in 5 seconds
C1.rule_name: First response within 5 seconds, with typing indicator

B3.name: Service naming
B3.rule_name: No forbidden or restricted platform wording

D1.name: Indicator before every message
D1.rule_name: Typing indicator before every outbound message, including rich features

E4.name: Escape option
E4.rule_name: No dead ends anywhere in the flow

D3.name: Reply latency
D3.rule_name: First response within 5 seconds, with typing indicator

D2.name: Bot indicator length
D2.rule_name: Typing indicator never hangs or misleads

A6.name: Clean screen
A6.rule_name: All rehearsal threads deleted before final recording

G3.name: Transfer announced
G3.rule_name: Handoff to a live agent is explicitly stated

H2.name: Clarifying question first
H2.rule_name: Personal data request is gated by a clarifying question

H7.name: Trigger words
H7.rule_name: Actionable keywords trigger the defined behaviour

A4.name: Out of hours
A4.rule_name: Off-hours automated message is accurate and non-deceptive

G2.name: Keywords
